Verify per-call cost integrity: for each {{per_call_costs}} entry, find matching agent in {{agent_totals}} and verify the cost_usd is ≤ that agent's average cost per call (total_cost / call_count). Also verify no negative costs or costs > 1000 USD exist (sanity bounds). Record any anomalies.
